note: Submodule of acquia_dam that bulk-creates media entities for DAM (Widen) assets in configured categories/asset groups. All configuration is the acquiadam_asset_import.settings config object: 'categories' (map Widen category UUID => [local media type ids]) and 'asset_groups' (map asset group UUID => [media type ids]); install default both {}. Config form /admin/config/acquia-dam/bulk-import (parent permission 'administer acquia_dam' + DAM-authenticated check). Three Drush commands drive a queue-based import (acquia-dam:import-assets / :queue-import-assets / :process-import-queue, opts --batch-size/--limit) into the acquia_dam_asset_import queue processed by the AssetImporter worker. Enumerating/creating assets needs a live DAM connection, so EVERY case here is grounded in local config only: medium reads a configured category->media-type mapping / counts configured categories; hard writes a category and an asset-group mapping and verifies via drush cget. The submodule is left ENABLED for the campaign so its settings config object exists.

evals.prompt: What does the Acquia DAM Bulk Asset Import submodule do, and how do you tell it which DAM assets to import and as what media type?
evals.expected_output: It bulk-creates Drupal media entities for DAM (Widen) assets. On its config form you map Widen category UUIDs and asset-group UUIDs to one or more local DAM media types; those maps are stored in acquiadam_asset_import.settings under 'categories' and 'asset_groups'. Import runs as a queue-based job.

evals.prompt: Which Drush commands does the Acquia DAM bulk import submodule provide to queue and run an import, and what options control batching and how many items are processed?
evals.expected_output: acquia-dam:queue-import-assets (ad:qia) enqueues; acquia-dam:process-import-queue (ad:piq) processes with --batch-size (default 10) and --limit (default 0 = unlimited); acquia-dam:import-assets (ad:ia) does both in one command.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with the Acquia DAM bulk import submodule, where is the mapping of Widen categories to media types stored, and at what admin path is it configured?
evals.expected_output: Stored in the acquiadam_asset_import.settings config object (keys 'categories' and 'asset_groups'), configured at /admin/config/acquia-dam/bulk-import (route acquiadam_asset_import.configuration), which needs the 'administer acquia_dam' permission and a DAM-authenticated site.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Acquia DAM bulk import has a Widen category configured for import. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which local media type that category's assets will be imported as.
evals.expected_output: The configured category (cat-uuid-eval-001) is mapped to the Image media type acquia_dam_image_asset in acquiadam_asset_import.settings:categories.

evals.prompt: How many Widen categories are currently configured for bulk import on this site? Inspect the live Acquia DAM bulk import configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: Two categories are configured in acquiadam_asset_import.settings:categories (cat-uuid-eval-aa and cat-uuid-eval-bb).

evals.prompt: Configure Acquia DAM bulk import so that assets in the Widen category with UUID 'cat-uuid-task-777' are imported as the Image media type (acquia_dam_image_asset). Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set acquiadam_asset_import.settings categories so that 'cat-uuid-task-777' maps to ['acquia_dam_image_asset'] (via the Bulk import form or drush config): ->set('categories', ['cat-uuid-task-777' => ['acquia_dam_image_asset']])->save();

evals.prompt: Configure Acquia DAM bulk import so that assets in the Widen asset group with UUID 'ag-uuid-task-888' are imported as the Video media type (acquia_dam_video_asset). Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set acquiadam_asset_import.settings asset_groups so that 'ag-uuid-task-888' maps to ['acquia_dam_video_asset']: ->set('asset_groups', ['ag-uuid-task-888' => ['acquia_dam_video_asset']])->save();
